title: feat(console): a footer calculation is a part of the list draft; a package view's refused save says why in the reader's words
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu3R6vTvrF8uP9Z2MFVbqmJV)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgX7ez5A7JDsmzTy9Ks

Fixes #36194
Fixes #36195

Clause-②: yes (widening) — two new keys in every `@object-ui/i18n` locale pack (`console.objectView.personalizedParts.summaries`, `console.objectView.saveRefused.packaged`); zh-Hant regenerated; nothing removed or renamed. `ListView` / `ObjectGrid` props unchanged (doc comments only).
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表底部选、换、去掉一列的统计：马上显示结果，不再写进视图或个人视图；和筛选排序一样算草稿，出现「放弃」「保存」，「保存」菜单的未保存列表多一项「统计」。「放弃」还原；「保存到这个视图」（自己的视图）和「另存为我的视图」把统计一起存进去。
- 包里带的视图（比如 HotCRM「全部客户」）、没有权限改的共享视图：照样能选统计，进草稿，「保存」里只有「另存为我的视图」。任何时候都不会再出现卡上那段英文报错。
- 服务端拒绝保存包里带的视图时，提示改成一句中文（11 种语言都有）：「这个视图来自应用包，不能直接修改，可以另存为我的视图。」其它拒绝照旧显示服务端那句话（那些是写给人看的，已有测试钉着）。
- 卡上那段报错的来历：包可写的判断要等包列表读回来，列表为了不和页面抢网络，要等页面请求安静下来（最多 8 秒）才读；这之前判断按设计放行，底部入口就直接写了视图。统计改成草稿后，这段时间里底部不再写任何东西。

## What changes

**A footer calculation is a draft part** (`objectViewListRenderer.tsx`, `listDraftStore.ts`, `columnSummaryWrite.ts`, `ObjectView.tsx`)

- `ListDraft` gains `summaries` (column → calculation, `null` = None over a column the view sums); an emptied part is no part. It lives exactly as the other parts (#35955 item 4: kept on a record round trip, dropped on another view or object and on a reload).
- The renderer lays the draft's calculations over the columns it hands `ListView` (`columnsWithSummaries`), so the grid draws them at once, and `onColumnSummaryPick` only patches the draft and answers `true`. A pick equal to the column's own calculation (`columnSummaryOf`) drops the column from the draft.
- The menu is offered (`columnSummaryPickFields`) on the columns the list draws, the reader's added fields included: the columns a saved body carries. Where the list holds no draft (an environment list, no open view) nothing is offered (`listViewActions.draftsSummaries`).
- Removed: `handlePickPersonalViewSummary` (wrote the reader's own view at once) and `handlePickSharedViewSummary` (wrote the shared view's draft, `PUT /meta/view/<name>?mode=draft`). No footer pick writes anything now.
- The Save menu's unsaved list names it: host-side part `summaries` (`ListDraftActions`' `ListPersonalizationPart` gains it; `ListView`'s own vocabulary is untouched), pushed in `objectViewListUrlState.ts` like `columns`.
- Saves carry it: `PersonalViewListState.summaries`, laid by `buildPersonalViewConfig` on the columns it keeps (after added fields, order and hidden columns). Callers: Save to this view (own view), Save as my view, the switcher's create card with "include current".

**A view the reader cannot change in place** — the same "can save in place" reading as the filter and the Save menu, no second rule: the Save menu offers Save to this view on the reader's own view only (on `main`), so a package's view and a non-admin's shared view get Save as my view alone. With #36123 merged in, its shared-view Save to this view keeps its own test (`canSaveToSharedView`, now waiting for the package list: small call 5) and stores the calculations too.

**A refused save of a package's view** (`viewSaveRefusal.ts`, `objectViewViewCrud.tsx`, `ObjectView.tsx`)

- `viewSaveRefusalText(err, t)`: `code === 'NOT_OVERRIDABLE'` (the door's close on an item a package ships, `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`) → `console.objectView.saveRefused.packaged`; anything else → `formatMetadataError` as before. Used at every view-write toast on the object page except delete (view settings save, create, rename, pin, set default, personal create / save / save as).

**Docs**: `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` § "A user's list state never writes the view". Changeset `36194-footer-calculation-draft.md`.

## Small calls made in this thread (Sales 22:19:27Z rule; seat agreed 22:51Z)

1. The menu is offered on every column the list draws, not only the ones the view declares: the draft can carry a calculation on any column the saved body keeps (#35702's declared-only limit existed because the pick wrote the view).
2. A reader who is no admin gets the menu on a shared view too (their pick is their draft; Save as my view keeps it). The card's "no entry for a reader without permission" acceptance line predates the fold; the brief settles it as "into the draft, Save as my view alone".
3. Only `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` is reworded. Other refusals (403 permission, 422 field issues, pin / default / rename) keep the door's message, which objectui#11583 / #12417 pin as worded for the person saving.
4. The switcher's create card carries the calculations only with "include current", as it does the filter and sort.
5. **Done after #36123 merged:** its 「保存到这个视图」 on a shared view stays hidden while the package list is unread, and for a package listed read-only (`usePackageSaveRead`: the same session-held read as `usePackageRefusesSaves`, with the in-flight state told apart; a failed read or an unlisted package still offers it, as today). Reason measured below: the unread window is where the card's error came from.

## Root cause of the card's error (measured, client-side)

HotCRM 6.5.0 on `main` (`fa304140`), console from this tree's `ui/` against it: the server's package list reports `app.objectstack.hotcrm` `writable: false`, and `crm_account.all_accounts`'s row carries `_packageId: app.objectstack.hotcrm`. The reading is right once read; but `fetchSessionPackages` waits for the page's own requests to go quiet (up to 8 s) before it reads, and until then `usePackageRefusesSaves` fails open by design. Measured at 1440: the list drew with 「+ 添加统计」 at 7.2 s, the package list answered at 8.0 s, and the entry went. A pick inside that window sent the `PUT ?mode=draft` the card shows. With this PR the pick writes nothing in any window.

## Tests

- `ObjectView.footerCalculationDraft-36194.test.tsx` (7, renamed from `ObjectView.readOnlyPackageView-35933.test.tsx`; real `ObjectView`, `ListView` stand-in that draws the condition row's end, every non-GET `fetch` recorded): a pick is drawn, writes nothing, Save names it, picking None again drops it; Discard takes it off; the reader's own view stores it only on Save to this view; a view that declares no columns gets the menu on the drawn columns and Save as my view stores it; a package's view: drawn, no write, Save offers Save as my view alone, which stores it; the package list unread: still a draft; a non-admin on a shared view: a draft, Save as my view alone.
- `__tests__/footerCalculationDraft-36194.test.ts` (9): `columnsWithSummaries` / `columnSummaryOf`; the draft store's empty part; `buildPersonalViewConfig` stores calculations on kept columns (added kept, hidden dropped) in a body `ListViewSchema` accepts; `viewSaveRefusalText` (package refusal reworded, a 403 keeps the door's words, issues keep the list).
- `AppContent.draftSaveKeepsList-35932.test.tsx` (8, adapted): the pick no longer writes, so the refresh pulse a draft save announces is announced by the test (`emitMetadataRefresh`); no skeleton, no remount, picks drawn through it; a reader's pick is offered (their draft).

## Verification

Local at head (`claude/project-thread-8r2qm4`):

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__ packages/app-shell/src/views/ListDraftActions packages/app-shell/src/views/personalViews packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent packages/i18n packages/plugin-list/src packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__` → 797 files, 8404 passed / 13 skipped; the 7 failures of that run were the first version of the refusal helper (it also reworded every 403) and a stale zh-Hant; both fixed, and the three files re-run green (`ObjectView.viewWriteRefusal-11583`, `ObjectView.createViewRefusal-11578`, `packages/i18n` 106 files).
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `eslint` on every changed file: 0 errors.
- The whole app-shell package is left to CI's shards.

## Since the first L1-b read (`ef54913f` → `efa7c4f0`)

- Merged `main` twice (#36128, then #36123). Resolutions: the renderer's memo deps take #36128's `openReferencedRecord` and keep this PR's drop of `summaryPickKey`; `ObjectView`, `personalViews`, `listDraftStore` and `views.mdx` keep both sides (calculations beside #36123's layout and row colour).
- The shared-view Save to this view passes `summaries` to `layListStateOverView`, which lays them after the added, ordered and hidden columns; it still writes neither the reader's row height nor column widths.
- Small call 5: `usePackageSaveRead` in `useStudioDesignGate.ts` (`unread` / `refuses` / `takes`); `canSaveToSharedView` asks for `takes`.
- L1-b N1: `viewSaveRefusalText` reads the code with `errorCodeIs`.
- Tests: three new cases in `ObjectView.sharedViewSave-35955.test.tsx` (a pick on a shared view writes nothing and Save to this view stores it with the view's own row height; unread package list hides the save, the answer offers it; a failed read offers it). Local: 203 files / 1769 tests green (ObjectView*, the gate hook, `views/__tests__`, the console draft test); app-shell type-check 0; eslint 0 errors.

## Evidence (HotCRM 6.5.0, 1440×900, `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/36194-36195/`)

- Before: `before-1440-{light,dark}-hotcrm-pick-refused.png` — 「全部客户」, the package list held 15 s to show the window, a 「去重」 pick: `PUT …/crm_account.all_accounts?mode=draft`, the English refusal toast.
- After (same hold): `after-1440-{light,dark}-hotcrm-pick-in-draft.png` (「去重 9」 drawn, 「放弃」「保存」, no write), `after-1440-{light,dark}-hotcrm-save-menu.png` (「未保存的改动: 统计」, 「另存为我的视图」 alone), `after-1440-light-hotcrm-discarded.png`, `after-1440-light-saved-as-my-view.png` (「全部客户 副本」 keeps 「去重 9」), `after-1440-light-my-view-save-menu.png` (own view: 「保存到这个视图」 offered), `after-1440-light-my-view-after-reload.png` (saved 「非空 9」 survives a reload; the only write of the run: `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_personal_view/<id>`).

## Overlap

`overlap-check.mjs` @ `efa7c4f0`: merges cleanly with `main` (`af2361ee`, #36123 and #36128 in); textual conflict with #36133 only (`listDraftStore.ts`, `objectViewListRenderer.tsx`).
